# The Trans-Solar Federation
The Trans-Solar Federation, also known as the TSF, SolGov, or simply the Federation, is the largest human-majority nation and de-facto superpower of the Orion Arm. Headquartered on Earth, the TSF is a unitary federal democracy in which only those who have performed a requisite five years of national service may vote or hold public office. Militaristic, assertive, and egalitarian, the Federation is a political chimera that has served as a bastion of capitalism and controlled liberty for centuries. With the strongest economy, industrial base, and armed forces in the known Sector, the TSF is a beacon of stability and power for all under its aegis.
## The Frontier
The Frontier is a sector on the edge of TSF space. It is administered by the Frontier Administration, a SolGov civil authority based on Frontier Outpost. The Administration handles access, trade, docking, and the day-to-day government of the sector.
The New Frontier Sheriff's Department (NFSD) is the TSF's frontier law-enforcement agency. Its deputies are TSF personnel, and its authority comes from SolGov, not from a private corporation. Central Command is the TSF's sector command, the authority above the Frontier Administration.
SolGov does not run every ship, shop, or contract in the Frontier. Free contractors and civilians are the backbone of the sector, and they are free to work for themselves or for any corporation that will hire them.
